# Ways of Working (WoW)

> The canonical developer platform, standards, and CLI for PM-as-Code and Two-Tier Agentic Review.

## Documentation Index

- [PM-as-Code Philosophy & Architecture](docs/pm-as-code.md): Core concepts, directory structure, initiative classification, and 4-stage task lifecycle.
- [Two-Tier Agentic Review Model](docs/two-tier-agent-review.md): Anti-blindness architecture, inner-loop Tier 1 vs outer-loop Tier 2, and P0/P1/P2 taxonomy.
- [Sibling Repository Adoption Guide](docs/adoption-guide.md): How to adopt these standards in any repository in 3 steps.

## Standards & Contracts

- [Agent Review Contract](standards/AGENT_REVIEW_CONTRACT.md): Severity taxonomy, proof-of-defect requirements, iteration bounds (max 2).
- [Tier 1 Reviewer Specification](standards/TIER_1_REVIEWER_SPEC.md): Fresh-context subagent rules, read-only permissions, 4 audit axes.
- [Review Verdict Schema](standards/schemas/review-verdict.schema.json): Universal JSON schema for machine-readable review verdicts.

## Starter Templates

- [AGENTS.md Template](templates/AGENTS.template.md): Starter operating manual for AI coding agents.
- [PRD Template](templates/prd-template.md): Standard Markdown template for feature specifications.
- [Task Template](templates/task-template.md): Standard Markdown template for agent task execution.
- [Areas Template](templates/areas.template.json): Template for architectural boundary mapping.
- [PR Template](templates/pull_request_template.md): Pull request template enforcing Evidence Pack inclusion.
